verdict.rationale: Rootly AI SRE explicitly investigates active alerts/incidents, 'tests likely causes against live evidence' and produces a reviewable diagnosis with next steps, correlating telemetry via AWS/CloudWatch connectors and matching against past incidents via find_related_incidents/TF-IDF similarity and Rootly AI's related-incidents matching — all before human intervention. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the AI SRE's diagnostic accuracy and no third-party benchmark of correlation quality.
